==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am by a lake. I am hovering just above the shore. I am surrounded by sparkling white light as a silver fairy approaches me.

The fairy summons a levitating creature that resembles a school desk with sharp pointed teeth. She calls the creature a face eater. She says that to keep my powers, I have to let it eat some quality of mine.

I think of many abstract things I could offer it, but each thing I think of seems to have equally abstract consequences. In the end, I agree to let it take my face. My head becomes a bone skull for a split second, but quickly returns to normal as a sign that I passed the test.
